brief: Holds a list of sets, each a list without repeated items; it builds only from an empty list today.
detail: Its init checks the argument with a method named IsListOfSets that stzList does not have (only the global function of that name exists), so new stzListOfSets(aList) raises error R14 for every non-empty list, and a value that is not a list raises R3 because the error text function is missing. Only an empty list builds. For one set use stzSet; for plain lists of lists use stzListOfLists.
